critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: AccountPanel.js imports LocalizationPanel and renders it inside the Organisation card after the org name. data-testid wiring intact.
LocalizationPanel.js correctly snaps currency+timezone to selected country, calls invalidateLocalization() after PUT, and toasts 'Market set to {country_name} · {currency}'. No issues spotted.

Minor (pre-existing, not blocking): a React hydration warning appears in console when the Account modal opens ('In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'). Originates from a Radix/Primitive select wrapping; not introduced by this slice but worth a future cleanup.
